<p class="main-heading">Engineering a More Accessible World</p>

<p class="hero-subtitle">I thrive on the challenge of translating complex human needs into functional, reliable engineering solutions. I am passionate about applying my skills to solve complex problems through intentional mechatronic design.</p>
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .hero-right-content}
<p class="hero-first-p">I'm a Junior Engineering student at Harvey Mudd College specializing in mechatronics. My academic work focuses on mechanics, digital and electronic systems, controls, and human-centred design. </p>

<p>Beyond the classroom, you can always find me tinkering with my personal projects - whether it's building a new electromechanical device or improving upon my previous designs, I'm always on the move to build highly reliable, real-world products.</p>

    <svg id="robotSvg" viewBox="120 80 340 1200" class="w-full h-auto" xmlns="[http://www.w3.org/2000/svg](http://www.w3.org/2000/svg)">
      <!-- Ground Baseline -->
      <line x1="60" y1="440" x2="440" y2="440" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8 8"/>

      <!-- Base Mount -->
      <g id="baseMount" transform="translate(250, 410)">

        <path d="M 0 -60 L 25 -60 L 38 0 L 10 0 Z" fill="#7FAEC0" opacity="0.6"/>
      </g>

      <!-- Joint 1: Shoulder -->
      <g id="shoulderGroup" class="smooth-arm" transform="translate(250, 350) rotate(0)">
        <path d="M -32 22 L -135 -120 C -150 -135, -125 -160, -90 -145 L 32 -10 Z" fill="#98C5D3" class="arm-stroke"/>
        <path d="M -125 -125 L -20 18 L 22 -2 L -100 -138 Z" fill="#7FAEC0" opacity="0.5"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="38" fill="#F08024" class="arm-stroke"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="18" fill="#E2F1F5" class="arm-stroke"/>

        <!-- Joint 2: Elbow -->
        <g id="elbowGroup" class="smooth-arm" transform="translate(-110, -140) rotate(0)">
          <path d="M -18 -15 L 85 -92 C 105 -105, 120 -75, 95 -60 L -5 18 Z" fill="#98C5D3" class="arm-stroke"/>
          <path d="M -5 -8 L 88 -82 L 95 -68 L -2 8 Z" fill="#BDDCED" opacity="0.8"/>
          <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="28" fill="#98C5D3" class="arm-stroke"/>
          <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="12" fill="#E2F1F5" class="arm-stroke"/>

          <!-- Joint 3: Wrist -->
          <g id="wristGroup" class="smooth-arm" transform="translate(95, -80) rotate(0)">
            <g id="wristCollar">
              <path d="M -8 -22 L 18 -32 L 28 8 L 2 18 Z" fill="#F08024" class="arm-stroke"/>
            </g>

            <!-- Claws -->
            <g id="clawTopGroup" class="smooth-arm" transform="translate(12, -18) rotate(0)">
              <path d="M 0 0 L 16 -16 L 38 -16 L 38 4" class="claw-stroke"/>
            </g>

            <g id="clawBottomGroup" class="smooth-arm" transform="translate(12, 0) rotate(0)">
              <path d="M 0 0 L 16 16 L 38 16 L 38 -4" class="claw-stroke"/>
            </g>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>
    </svg>
  </div>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const shoulderGroup = document.getElementById('shoulderGroup');
      const elbowGroup = document.getElementById('elbowGroup');
      const wristGroup = document.getElementById('wristGroup');
      const clawTopGroup = document.getElementById('clawTopGroup');
      const clawBottomGroup = document.getElementById('clawBottomGroup');
      const grabbedWord = document.getElementById('grabbedWord');
      const armStageWrapper = document.getElementById('armStageWrapper');

      let currentStep = 0;

      const sequence = [
        { shoulder: 0, elbow: 0, wrist: 0, claw: 0, armX: 0, textX: 0, textY: 0, delay: 1200 },
        { shoulder: 58, elbow: -48, wrist: -32, claw: 18, armX: 40, textX: 0, textY: 0, delay: 1000 },
        { shoulder: 64, elbow: -56, wrist: -38, claw: -8, armX: 55, textX: 0, textY: 0, delay: 600 },
        { shoulder: 20, elbow: -10, wrist: -5, claw: -8, armX: 10, textX: -40, textY: -25, delay: 1100 },
        { shoulder: 64, elbow: -56, wrist: -38, claw: -8, armX: 55, textX: 0, textY: 0, delay: 1100 },
        { shoulder: 58, elbow: -48, wrist: -32, claw: 18, armX: 40, textX: 0, textY: 0, delay: 600 },
        { shoulder: 0, elbow: 0, wrist: 0, claw: 0, armX: 0, textX: 0, textY: 0, delay: 1600 }
      ];

      function executeStep() {
        const step = sequence[currentStep];

        shoulderGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(250, 350) rotate(${step.shoulder})`);
        elbowGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(-110, -140) rotate(${step.elbow})`);
        wristGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(95, -80) rotate(${step.wrist})`);
        clawTopGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(12, -18) rotate(${-step.claw})`);
        clawBottomGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(12, 0) rotate(${step.claw})`);

        if (armStageWrapper) {
          armStageWrapper.style.transition = `transform ${step.delay}ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)`;
          armStageWrapper.style.transform = `translateX(${step.armX}px)`;
        }

        if (grabbedWord) {
          grabbedWord.style.transition = `transform ${step.delay}ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)`;
          grabbedWord.style.transform = `translate(${step.textX}px, ${step.textY}px)`;
        }

        currentStep = (currentStep + 1) % sequence.length;
        setTimeout(executeStep, step.delay);
      }

      executeStep();
    });
  </script>
